correctness.rationale: The factorial-unit recurrence proves an exact mod-3^k expression. Separated ternary digit blocks factor the unit and count v carries, n+1=1 modulo 3^k, giving C_n=3^v d_k^v c_k^t. The explicit 2 mod 9 central-binomial congruence and 3-adic lifting prove c_k generates the full unit group; this provides all residue classes and infinite witness indices. Direct integer Catalan and 3-adic-oracle tests corroborate k<=7 but are not extrapolated.
